name: DFW 2012 to 2016 two-story, 2009 IRC
description: Two-story slab house permitted 2012 to August 2016 under the 2009 IRC. Values follow what the DOE Texas field study measured in homes built to this code. Some suburbs (Plano, Frisco, McKinney) were on the 2012 IECC, closer to the 2016 to 2020 template. Inspect and override.

era.code_basis: 2009 IRC Chapter 11 statewide from January 2012 until the 2015 IRC took effect September 1, 2016 (SECO); some DFW suburbs on the 2012 IECC by 2014.

style.typical_cladding: brick veneer, siding on upper walls

sources.citation: RhoeFlow DFW era template research (claude/01-plan/dfw-era-template-research.md), section Era by era: 2012 to 2016. Every value, its range, evidence type and confidence.
Texas SECO, single-family energy code history: no statewide code before September 2001; 2000 IECC 2001-2011; 2009 IRC from 2012; 2015 IRC from September 2016

2009 IECC Chapter 4 (same as 2009 IRC Chapter 11), climate zone 3: U 0.50, SHGC 0.30, ceiling R-30, wall R-13; under 7 ACH50 if tested; attic supply ducts R-8; leakage to outside 8 cfm25 per 100 ft2 or less

DOE/PNNL Texas Residential Field Study, Phase I (2017), 2009 IRC homes in climate zone 2A: mean 4.7 ACH50, total duct leakage 6.9 cfm25 per 100 ft2, ceiling R-35.6, window U 0.34 and SHGC 0.22, attic ducts R-6.1

ceiling_insulation_cavity_r.basis: Code R-30; Texas field study measured a mean of R-35.6, rounded to the poor side. Measure the depth and override.

wall_insulation_cavity_r.basis: Code R-13; field-measured wall assemblies match.

window_ufactor.basis: Texas field study measured a mean U 0.34 (code maximum 0.50). Read the NFRC label and override.

window_shgc.basis: Texas field study measured a mean SHGC 0.22 (code maximum 0.30), rounded to the poor side.

air_leakage.basis: Texas field study measured a mean of 4.7 ACH50 (code under 7 if tested). A blower-door result replaces this.

duct_insulation_r.basis: Texas field study measured R-6.1 attic ducts (code R-8 for attic supply). Read the jacket label.

duct_leakage_to_outside.basis: Field-measured total leakage averaged 6.9 cfm25 per 100 ft2, which caps leakage to outside (code limit 8 to outside). A duct-blaster result replaces this.
